title: Mi:dm 2.0 Korea-centric Bilingual Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper measured social bias related to religion using the KoBBQ benchmark, which evaluates models' inherent bias across 12 topics in both ambiguous and disambiguous contexts.
findings: In the KoBBQ benchmark for social bias, the Mi:dm 2.0 Base model achieved scores of 79.17 in ambiguous contexts and 78.75 in disambiguated contexts for the 'Religion' category. The smaller Mi:dm 2.0 Mini model scored 56.78 and 51.06 in the same respective categories.
